args.title: Redwood Ridge Team Offsite — Venue Screening Checklist
args.body:
# Redwood Ridge Team Offsite — Venue Screening Checklist

## Hard gates — reject venue if any answer is “No”

- [ ] Venue supports a one-day, product-deep working offsite.
- [ ] Business-grade internet is confirmed in writing by a direct property-operations contact.
- [ ] Internet confirmation specifies dedicated service, expected speeds, outage history, and onsite support.
- [ ] A live hardline Ethernet connection is available in the working room.
- [ ] Guest Wi-Fi has no captive portal and can support demos and video calls.
- [ ] Working room is available for the full required day and fits the complete team comfortably.
- [ ] Room supports product demos, screen sharing, and collaborative working.
- [ ] Display, HDMI/USB-C connectivity, power, and whiteboards are confirmed.
- [ ] Venue provides a credible backup plan for internet or AV failure.
- [ ] Combined flight and hotel cost per attendee stays below $2,000.
- [ ] Any amount over $5,000 is identified for manual review before payment.

## Venue and room details

- [ ] Address, travel time, parking, and transit options are documented.
- [ ] Room layout, capacity, dimensions, natural light, noise level, and privacy are confirmed.
- [ ] Setup and breakdown windows cover the planned agenda.
- [ ] Accessibility, restrooms, temperature control, and building access are acceptable.
- [ ] Venue contact and day-of property-operations contact are identified.

## Working-session fit

- [ ] Proposed agenda can prioritize product work, live demos, and working blocks.
- [ ] Venue can support short demos before working sessions.
- [ ] Space does not require investor-facing programming or team-building activities.
- [ ] Remote attendance needs are assessed; add a Zoom backup if needed.
- [ ] Any remote-first or rural venue has written connectivity confirmation before consideration.

## Meals and dietary logistics

- [ ] Tava Kitchen is the default meal vendor unless dietary needs require another option.
- [ ] Lunch delivery window, drop-off point, and onsite recipient are confirmed.
- [ ] Headcount and dietary requirements are recorded, including vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free meals.
- [ ] Dietary labels, separate packaging, serving supplies, and sauces or dressings are confirmed.
- [ ] Dinner, snacks, printed menus, and other add-ons are excluded unless separately approved.

## Budget, ownership, and approvals

- [ ] HR owns the budget and Sarah Kim is included in retreat arrangements.
- [ ] Quote separates room, AV, internet, meals, travel, taxes, service charges, and add-ons.
- [ ] Cancellation, attrition, deposit, and payment terms are documented.
- [ ] No commitment is made before required budget and manual-review approvals.
- [ ] Vendor invoice process can prevent unapproved add-ons.

## Evidence to collect before final comparison

- [ ] Written property-operations confirmation of internet and room setup.
- [ ] Itemized venue quote and contract terms.
- [ ] Travel-cost estimate showing flight and hotel totals.
- [ ] Proposed room diagram, equipment list, and backup plan.
- [ ] Catering proposal with locked counts and dietary handling.
- [ ] Named venue, HR, Sarah Kim, and day-of contacts.

## Decision record

- Venue: ______________________________
- Property-operations contact: ______________________________
- Proposed date and hours: ______________________________
- Estimated total cost: ______________________________
- Flight and hotel cost per attendee: ______________________________
- Internet confirmation received on: ______________________________
- Open risks or exceptions: ______________________________
- Final approver: ______________________________
- Decision: ☐ Shortlist ☐ Reject ☐ Needs clarification
